EmailTemplate.name: PerformSmart Outreach Initial Email
EmailTemplate.subject: PerformSmart Outreach Initial Email
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
My name is {Logged in users First Name} and I will be your Account Transition Specialist for PerformSmart at Insperity. Our system indicates that your first review is scheduled to be kicked off in approximately one month.
I have included some of our quick guides and a webinar video for preparing and kicking off a review cycle (with the links below). If you have any questions after reviewing our quick guides, we're more than happy to schedule a call to ensure a successful launch of your upcoming review cycle. If you would like a call, please inform us of your availability for this/next week. This call should not take more than 20-30 minutes.
Preparing for a review cycle checklist: https://help.insperity.com/bps/knowledge-base/preparing-for-a-review-cycle-checklist/
Review Cycle Guide for Administrators: https://help.insperity.com/bps/knowledge-base/performance-management-review-cycle-guide-for-administrators/
How to setup and kickoff a review cycle webinar: http://video.insperity.com/BPSPM/setting_up_and_kicking_off_a_review_cycle.mp4
I look forward to hearing from you.
